---
title: "Does the span-constraint sink-rate penalty move under the library mass model?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 107.5      # s the probe actually used

stall_angle = 6.7
span_base = 0.76
span_fuse = 0.508

sink_hand_b, opt_hand_b = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=span_base)
sink_hand_f, opt_hand_f = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=span_fuse)
pen_h = sink_hand_f - sink_hand_b

sink_lib_b, opt_lib_b = optimize_geometry_library(get_airplane, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=span_base)
sink_lib_f, opt_lib_f = optimize_geometry_library(get_airplane, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=span_fuse)
pen_l = sink_lib_f - sink_lib_b

delta_pen = pen_l - pen_h
delta_pen_mm = delta_pen * 1000
delta_pen_pct = (delta_pen / pen_h) * 100

rel_pen_hand = (pen_h / sink_hand_b) * 100
rel_pen_lib = (pen_l / sink_lib_b) * 100

moves_str = "Yes" if abs(delta_pen_mm) > 1.0 else "No"

assert abs(delta_pen_mm) > 1.0
assert pen_l < pen_h
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{moves_str}, {pen_l:.2f} m/s"`]{.hero-value}
[span-constraint sink penalty under library mass model]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. Under the [library mass model](2026-09-30-01-does-replacing-hand-rolled-mass-geometry-with-wing-area-and-fuselage-v.qmd), the span-constraint sink-rate penalty decreases slightly from [`{python} f"{pen_h:.2f} m/s"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{pen_l:.2f} m/s"`]{.key}, a difference of [`{python} f"{abs(delta_pen_mm):.1f} mm/s"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{abs(delta_pen_pct):.1f}%"`]{.key}). Axial frustum integration saves fuselage foam mass almost identically on both the [unconstrained planform baseline](2026-09-30-03-does-the-stall-bounded-sink-rate-move-under-the-library-mass-model.qmd) and the [span-constrained design](2026-09-29-04-how-much-trimmed-sink-rate-is-given-up-with-span-held-to-0-508-m.qmd), leaving the relative penalty essentially unchanged at [`{python} f"{rel_pen_lib:.1f}%"`]{.key} compared to [`{python} f"{rel_pen_hand:.1f}%"`]{.key} (@tbl-penalty-comparison).

```{python}
#| label: tbl-penalty-comparison
#| tbl-cap: "Comparison of span-constraint sink penalty under hand-rolled versus library mass models."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

header = ["Metric", "Hand-rolled", "Library", "Delta"]
rows = [
    ("Baseline sink (b = 0.76 m)", f"{sink_hand_b:.2f} m/s", f"{sink_lib_b:.2f} m/s", f"{(sink_lib_b - sink_hand_b)*1000:.1f} mm/s"),
    ("Constrained sink (b = 0.508 m)", f"{sink_hand_f:.2f} m/s", f"{sink_lib_f:.2f} m/s", f"{(sink_lib_f - sink_hand_f)*1000:.1f} mm/s"),
    ("Span penalty", f"{pen_h:.2f} m/s", f"{pen_l:.2f} m/s", f"{delta_pen_mm:.1f} mm/s"),
    ("Relative penalty", f"{rel_pen_hand:.1f}%", f"{rel_pen_lib:.1f}%", f"{rel_pen_lib - rel_pen_hand:+.1f}%"),
]
md_table(header, rows)
```
